summary: EVAVO Godot Game Test Lab independently inspects, validates, executes and captures evidence from external Godot projects; provisions checksum-verified managed engines; runs native authored, deterministic bot and no-network sandbox QA; analyses retained media; and compiles exact game-asset, visual-animation and rig-motion admission evidence. It may write managed caches and governed evidence outside target repositories, with create-only semantics where each admission contract requires them, but does not repair, edit, publish or grant deployment authority over target repositories.

capabilities.title: Provision governed Godot engines
capabilities.description: Select, download or reuse official stable Godot editor and export-template archives under governed version/flavor policy, verify checksum identity and retain managed installation receipts outside target repositories.
requires: Official godotengine/godot-builds source or approved offline source
Managed engine root distinct from target repository

capabilities.title: Inspect and audit Godot projects
capabilities.description: Inspect one allowed external project and run bounded scene, resource, path, Git materialization, export and asset integrity checks without executing or modifying the target project.

capabilities.title: Run authoritative Godot validation
capabilities.description: Run exact-source integrity, optional .NET build, authoritative Godot import, recovery diagnosis, bounded headless/native runs, deterministic recording and optional export while retaining reports and artifacts. Target repair and publication are outside this authority.
requires: Downstream authority for target repair or publication

capabilities.title: Run exact-SHA native authored QA
capabilities.description: Run target-authored native Windows Godot journeys against exact lab and target SHAs, retaining bounded screenshots, movies, logs, telemetry and synchronized audio evidence outside both repositories. Non-interactive runs are contract tests, not native evidence.
requires: Exact lab SHA and target SHA
Interactive Windows session for authoritative native visual evidence

capabilities.title: Run deterministic bot QA
capabilities.description: Execute bounded deterministic fresh-process bot playtesting across mouse, keyboard, actions and gamepad-event paths, retaining replay/state/media evidence while explicitly not claiming complete state coverage or physical-controller proof.
requires: Exact lab SHA and target SHA

capabilities.title: Run isolated Linux Godot QA
capabilities.description: Prepare an ephemeral bounded copy and run Linux Godot validation/capture under the governed sandbox surface with retained logs and artifacts. Linux software-rendering evidence is not native Windows GPU performance evidence and the target repository remains outside repair/publication authority.
requires: Sandbox working root distinct from target

capabilities.title: Analyse retained gameplay media
capabilities.description: Extract and analyse synchronized audio and retained gameplay movies with governed FFmpeg/FFprobe media policy, writing analysis artifacts while keeping human mix and visual-quality judgment separate.

capabilities.title: Admit exact installed game-asset deliveries
capabilities.description: Independently bind an exact game head, delivery bundle, storage admission, installed bytes and optional native evidence into create-only game-asset delivery admission evidence. Native composition approval and publication remain false.
requires: Optional native evidence for full pass

capabilities.title: Admit Brass visual-animation evidence
capabilities.description: Independently verify exact static candidate/frame bytes, SpriteFrames references, Art Studio evaluations and Godot engine evidence into the Brass visual-animation Test Lab report while retaining creative, historical and publication approvals as false.
requires: Passed Art Studio static or animation evaluation

capabilities.title: Run exact-byte rig-motion acceptance v4.1
capabilities.description: Run an isolated hash-bound headless Godot rig-motion probe for supported 3D asset families, require measurable motion and write create-only acceptance evidence for named human review. Runtime admission, target mutation, Git mutation, deployment and publication remain false.
requires: Exact SHA-256 for Godot executable, asset, rig manifest and probe
Named human review after technical acceptance
